snippet.title: Cryorise | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Precision meets tranquility.

Cryorise is a 2D pixel-art platformer where every jump, dash, and throw counts. Play as a skilled Black heroine as she overcomes challenging levels filled with teleports, throwable items, and environmental puzzles that turn movement into art.

Inspired by Celeste and other precision platformers, Cryorise invites players to test their reflexes and creativity across beautifully crafted stages. With its comforting soundtrack and calming atmosphere, every challenge feels like progress — not punishment.

Key Features:
-Tight and satisfying 2D precision platforming
-Teleports, throwable tools, and puzzle-like mechanics
-Increasingly challenging levels with evolving gameplay
-A soothing yet motivating tone and soundtrack
-Striking pixel-art environments and animation

Wishlist Cryorise on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4063600/Cryorise/
